facts.fact: Health minister Amine Tehraoui told the House of Representatives on 1 June 2026 that the ministry is still working to put in place the unified medical record, meant to follow a patient across levels of care, and reported no facility count or completion date.
The health minister presented the unified medical record on 1 June 2026 as a project the Ministry of Health and Social Protection is itself putting in place.
